description: This file defines the StateType enumeration and related classes and functions for managing accessibility states in the pyatspi library, including state constants, a StateType class, and a StateSet class with methods for state management.

classes.name: StateType
classes.description: Enumeration class representing various accessibility states.

classes.name: StateSet
classes.description: Class for managing sets of states with methods to initialize, retrieve, and check states.

methods.name: stateset_init
methods.description: Initializes a StateSet instance with given states.

methods.name: StateSet_getStates
methods.description: Returns a list of StateType instances representing the current states in the set.
